OlxConnectorPrivacy.title: Privacy notice
OlxConnectorPrivacy.intro: This notice explains what the Talanty — olx.uz Connector handles when you choose to connect an olx.uz account.

collected.title: Data the connector transfers
collected.body: After you press Connect in Talanty, the connector reads the OLX access, refresh, and identity tokens, OLX device ID and request fingerprint, browser identification, and the first-party OLX cookie header needed for authenticated OLX requests. It sends this data only to the Talanty origin that created the one-time connection request.

notCollected.title: Data the connector does not collect
notCollected.body: The connector does not read or send your OLX password, CAPTCHA answer, SMS or OTP code, page form contents, or API response bodies. Enter verification details only on the official olx.uz website.

use.title: Why the data is used
use.body: Talanty uses the connection data only to verify the OLX account and perform OLX vacancy publication actions that you start. It is not used for advertising, profiling, or sale to third parties.

security.title: Storage and security
security.body: Connection data is sent over HTTPS and encrypted at rest with authenticated AES-256-GCM encryption. The extension keeps pending connection details only in Chrome session storage and does not persist the OLX connection data in extension local storage.

control.title: Your control
control.body: You can disconnect olx.uz in Talanty at any time. Disconnecting deletes the saved OLX connection from your Talanty account. You can also remove the browser extension in Chrome.

contact.title: Questions
contact.body: For privacy or connection questions, contact the administrator or support contact provided for your Talanty account. Never send them your OLX password, verification codes, or browser-session data.
